text: Four words REPLACED between middle and newest, each consistently: Q (the opening, (hornbox+dot seed)(mbox-sweep wide)(fishhook arrow)(box-curl+dot arrow)(hornbox+dot wide)(door+dot wide)) → (hornbox+dot arrow)(box-curl+dot horn)(box-curl moon)(hornbox horn)(tree+dot+loop moon); X (box-curl wide)(box-point arrow)(wave arrow) → (mbox-sweep moon)(lean-low arrow); Y (tree+loop arrow)(hornbox+dot arrow)(egg wide) → (mbox-sweep moon)(hornbox+dot horn)(tree+dot+loop moon)(box-curl horn)(egg moon); V (box-curl+dot wide)(tree+dot+loop seed) → (door+loop arrow)(egg arrow). Dropped: (tree wide)(tree+dot+loop arrow), (fishhook wide)(wave wide) = D2, (door seed)(hornbox arrow). X and Y are the same words the west chapel replaced, so they were changed again.
